info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account RealUser API
Returns the list of real user favorite charts from a client or a division.

items.docs: Returns the list of real user favorite charts from a client or a division.

params.name: favoritechartIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of real user favorite chart IDs

items.docs: Returns the real user favorite chart details based on the favorite chart ID.

info.name: Returns the real user favorite chart data based on the ID and the parameters.

params.name: favoriteChartId
params.description: Real user favorite chart ID

params.name: startTimeUtc
params.description: Start Time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: endTimeUtc
params.description: End Time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: timeInterval
params.description: Time interval window to aggregate data (refer InternalLink[Real User Application Enumeration,operations-tag-RealUser,operations-RealUser-get_v2_realuser_explorer_enumeration])

params.name: siteIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of site IDs to get favorite chart data for.

items.docs:
*[Analytics Endpoint]*
            
The favorite chart data returned is in UTC time.
            
**Note:**
- Time interval "Second" is only valid for timeframes less than or equal to 30 minutes.
- Similarly, time interval "Minutes1" is only valid for timeframes less than or equal to 12 hours.
- Using these time intervals with other timeframes will result in an error response.

info.name: Returns the real user explorer data by site ID and filters.

params.name: siteIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of site IDs

params.name: startTimeUtc
params.description: Start Time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: endTimeUtc
params.description: End Time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: subSourceTypeId
params.description: Sub Source Type ID to return Sub Source Data. “1” for Provider; “2” for Ajax; “6” for Zone

params.name: timeInterval
params.description: Time interval window to aggregate data (refer InternalLink[Real User Application Enumeration,operations-tag-RealUser,operations-RealUser-get_v2_realuser_explorer_enumeration])

params.name: dimensionIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Dimension IDs (refer InternalLink[Real User Application Enumeration,operations-tag-RealUser,operations-RealUser-get_v2_realuser_explorer_enumeration])

params.name: metricIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of metric IDs (refer InternalLink[Real User Application Enumeration,operations-tag-RealUser,operations-RealUser-get_v2_realuser_explorer_enumeration]). Default metrics based on SubSourceTypeId are returned if no value is passed.

params.name: tracepointIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Tracepoint IDs

params.name: indicatorIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Indicator IDs

params.name: zoneTypeIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Zone Type IDs. ”-2” for Self Zone and “-3” for Third Party Zone.

params.name: filters
params.description: Add filter dimension, filter value and flag

info.name: Returns the real user enumeration details for automation.

params.name: subSourceId
params.description: Sub Source Type ID to return Sub Source Data. “1” for Provider; “2” for Ajax; “6” for Zone

params.name: includeDimensions
params.description: Set to “true” to return enumerations of dimensions.

params.name: includeMetrics
params.description: Set to “true” to return enumerations of metrics.

params.name: includeSubSourceTypes
params.description: Set to “true” to return enumerations of sub sources.

params.name: includeTimeIntervals
params.description: Set to “true” to return enumerations of time intervals.

items.docs: Use parameters to specify which enumeration to pull, if no parameter is passed then it returns all the enumerations. Returns the enumeration based on the parameters.
